procedural_matters: A protest committee member received a request to reopen hearing #15 ( a request for redress) from 194228 on July 14, 2026 at 16:23 PDT The request was received after the deadline stated in SI 16.8 Pursuant to RRS 63.7(c), the protest committee met to consider the request The Protest Committee determined that the request did not meet the requirements of RRS 63.7(b)(2) and is invalid The Protest Committee also determined that it may have made a significant error per RRS 63.7(a)(2) and scheduled a reopening hearing for July, 20, 2026 at 10:00 EDT Pursuant to RRS 63.7(c)(s), the Protest Committee added Steven Wolff as a new member The Protest Committee posted the hearing through the ONB, and sent emails to 194228 and 225324 advising of an online hearing at the scheduled time. Multiple phone calls were also placed to 225324 225324 did not attend the hearing and the Protest Committee proceeded under RRS 63.1(b)
facts: s #11 & #12 on July 12 at the request of 194228 194228 testified that the race numbers were misstated on the protest forms #11 & #12 and neither party disagreed The decision of hearing #15 was that hearings #11 & #12 as delivered were not properly identified and thus found invalid. The PC vacated the decisions in hearings #11 & #12, reinstating 335324 in races # 4 & #5 at that time The PC became aware of World Sailing Q&A 2026.005 on July 14, 2026
conclusions: The PC erred in hearing #15 by not considering the guidance regarding according to Q&A 2026-005 in their decision to deem hearing requests #11 & 12 invalid The race numbers for hearing #11 & #12 are races # 5 & 6 respectively
decision: The decisions for hearings #11 & 12 are reversed, and 225324 is DSQ from races 5 & 6
